summary: The speaker reflects on the stealth helicopter mission to capture Bin Laden in Afghanistan, noting the surprise of seeing the aircraft and the high stakes involved in the operation. He discusses the subsequent tragedy of the loss of 31 Americans in Operation Enduring Freedom and explains his decision to extend his service until August to honor those sacrifices before retiring. Finally, he addresses the psychological impact of eliminating a high-profile target like Bin Laden and confirms he feels ready to move forward.
